$comment: Hybrid SDD per-project configuration. Copy to .sdd/config.json at the repository root.
$comment_worktree: run_phase.sh works in .sdd/worktrees/<NNN-phaseN>. worktreeSetup runs once per new worktree (install deps, link data).

agent.$comment: Shell commands used to launch one-shot model sessions. {PROMPT_FILE} is replaced by a file path.

$comment_parallel: true = first attempt runs consecutive [P] tasks with disjoint paths as concurrent implementer sessions (Spec Kit [P] semantics).
$comment_acceptanceLanes: Time optimisation (METHOD §11): files matching a lane regex (repo-relative path) run in that lane; lanes run concurrently up to acceptanceParallel (1 = sequential, the safe default); files in one lane run in order. {LANE} in acceptanceRun = lane name.
$comment_serve: Start the app under test FROM THE WORKTREE on servePort; tests and ui_probe read SDD_BASE_URL / SDD_PORT. Empty = no server.
$comment_failureMarkers: Literal substrings, or regex when prefixed with re: (e.g. "re:Failed: [1-9]"). Exit codes alone are not trusted.
$comment_hooks: Spec Kit .specify/extensions.yml hooks run automatically around each phase (scripts/hooks.mjs). Extra shell hooks: hooks.before_implement / hooks.after_implement arrays.

uiProbe.$comment: baseUrl is overridden by SDD_BASE_URL when gates.mjs serves the worktree.
